standard_prerequisites.name: Definition of pushforward: (g*f)(W) = F(g^{-1}W) for W open in Z
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the two evaluations being compared.

core_obligations: For W open in Z, (g composition f)_*F(W) is F((g composition f)^{-1}W) by the definition of pushforward (proof lines 2263-2264), and (g_* composition f_*)F(W) is f_*F(g^{-1}W) = F(f^{-1}g^{-1}W) (proof lines 2264-2266). Since (g composition f)^{-1}W = f^{-1}g^{-1}W as open subsets of X (proof line 2266), the two evaluations agree for every W, so the functors are equal on presheaves and hence on sheaves of sets (proof lines 2263-2267).
proof_roadmap: Evaluate (g composition f)_*F on an open W of Z (proof lines 2263-2264).
Evaluate g_* then f_* on the same W and compare using the preimage identity (proof lines 2264-2267).
